consent.terms: I accept the Terms and Privacy Policy
consent.guardian: If you are under 18, a parent or guardian has agreed to your use.

onboarding.categoriesBody: You can rename, change or add more any time.
onboarding.incomeBody: This helps us show what's left to assign. You can skip this.
onboarding.goalBody: Add a goal like an emergency fund. You can skip this.
onboarding.lockBody: Lock the app with your fingerprint or PIN.
onboarding.reminderBody: A gentle nudge to log your spending. You can turn it off any time.

budget.title: Budget
budget.copyLastBody: This replaces any amounts you have set for this month.

add.title: Add transaction
add.duplicateBody: You added the same amount a moment ago. Add it again?

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.reconcileBody: Enter the real balance. We'll add an adjustment for the difference.

lock.title: {{app}} is locked
lock.forgotPinBody: You'll sign out and sign back in. Your data stays safe in the cloud.
lock.tooMany: Too many tries. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.

privacy.title: Your data stays yours
privacy.storedBody: Your email, the entries you add, and your settings.
privacy.whereBody: On your device and in Google Firebase, encrypted in transit and at rest.
privacy.notCollectedBody: Your location, contacts, messages, or advertising ID. No ads, no analytics.
privacy.crashReportsBody: Helps us fix bugs. Never includes your entries.

delete.accountBody: This permanently deletes your account and all your data from our servers and this device. This can't be undone.
delete.dataBody: This permanently deletes your transactions, budgets, wishlist and settings. Your account stays.
delete.reauth: For your safety, please sign in again to continue.

notifications.weeklyBody: Tap to see how it went.
notifications.permissionOff: Reminders are off. Turn them on in your phone's settings.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't connect right now. Your changes are saved and will sync later.
errors.save: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
errors.permission: You don't have access to that.
errors.signIn: We couldn't sign you in. Please try again.
errors.wrongPassword: That email or password isn't right.
errors.emailInUse: That email is already in use.
errors.boundaryBody: The app hit a problem. Restarting usually fixes it.
errors.updateBody: This version is no longer supported. Update to keep your data syncing.

empty.transactionsBody: Add your first one to get started.
empty.budgetBody: Add a category to start planning.
empty.billsBody: Add a repeating bill and we'll remind you.
empty.searchBody: Try a different word or clear the filters.

coach.home: This is your month at a glance. Unassigned is money that still needs a job.
coach.budget: Tap an amount to change it. Bars turn yellow at 80% and red when you go over.
coach.add: Type the amount, pick a category, and save. You can calculate right in the amount.

review.title: Enjoying the app?

whatsNew.title: What's new in {{version}}
whatsNew.v1_0_0: Welcome! Budget by month, track spending, save for goals, and sync across your devices.

faq.a1: It's this month's income minus what you've planned in your budget. Aim for zero: every cedi has a job.
faq.q2: Does the app connect to my bank or mobile money?
faq.a2: No. You enter your own transactions. The app can't move money or read your accounts.
faq.a3: Yes. Everything works offline and syncs automatically when you're back online.
faq.q4: How do I use it on another phone?
faq.a4: Install the app, sign in with the same account, and your data appears.
faq.q5: What's the difference between Spent and Saved?
faq.a5: Spent is money you used. Saved is money you set aside for goals or your wishlist.
faq.a6: Your total balance minus money you've set aside for goals.
faq.a7: Set a repeat on any transaction. Choose to add it automatically or be asked first.
faq.a8: Tap Forgot PIN, sign out, and sign in again. Your data stays in the cloud.
faq.q9: How do I export my data?
faq.a9: Settings, then Data, then Export. You can choose CSV or JSON.
faq.q10: How do I delete my account?
faq.a10: Settings, then Account, then Delete account. This is permanent.
faq.q11: Can I recover something I deleted?
faq.a11: Yes, for 30 days. Go to Settings, then Data, then Recently deleted.
faq.a12: Yes. Only you can read it. You can also lock the app and hide amounts.
